note: Patches other mods make to the same code, the same way, as one of our switches. Exactly one copy may run: while the other mod's patch is active (installed, its mixin listed for this side, its option on), our switch steps aside; otherwise our switch applies and the other mod's mixin is cancelled. See bons.furious.guard.ForeignPatches. Checked against Collections Of Optimizations 4.4 (CurseForge file 9026925, sha1 d1b067885b0827c12b7eb75bc02896d270adaed8) on 2026-10-02. The Collections Of Optimizations 4.6 entries are carried from the Forge 1.0.36 release for the keys this port ships; they only act when that mod is installed, which no NeoForge 1.21.1 test of this port has.

yields.name: Collections Of Optimizations
yields.why: Both run RenderSystem.limitDisplayFPS just before Window.updateDisplay. Called twice in a row the limiter waits a second full frame interval, so with both on every frame waits twice and a frame-rate cap is halved (vsync off).

yields.name: Collections Of Optimizations

yields.name: ServerCore
yields.why: ServerCore's mixin @Redirects the same call our switch @Redirects: ServerLevel.isNaturalSpawningAllowed(ChunkPos) inside ServerChunkCache.tickChunks. Mixin applies only one @Redirect of a call, so the second one fails; with ServerCore installed our switch steps aside and ServerCore keeps its own change. ServerCore's settings file is YAML, which is not read here, so the switch steps aside whenever ServerCore lists the mixin.
